our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes the condition a shortage of capacity to serve demand.

criteria.support_condition: Confirmed capacity pressure is followed by a material, sustained deterioration in comparable service availability, with evidence connecting the deterioration to that pressure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable reliability measurements show that confirmed capacity pressure did not produce the predicted deterioration during the relevant episode. A finite period without deterioration cannot conclusively refute an unrestricted future prediction.
